liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (3 reviews): First set is top notch, with Jack Straw and Big River played with passion; Jack Straw and Bertha sizzle, while the Help On The Way set closer is described as sick [18][25][28]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Transition into the song is the most outstanding live performance the reviewer ever heard [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-09-19.138055.mtx.photoleon.t-flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 185 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1990-09-19.mtx.hansokolow.fix-96157.97641.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 188 min [2]
- **gd90-09-19.schoeps-fob.wiley.11664.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 189 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [5]. Said about its sound: Recording captures high energy but has skips and glitches during the peak of the song; Source disk scratches cause mis-tracks and repeats during the song, though the copy is superior [17][20]
- **gd90-09-19.sbd.jeffm.3373.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 169 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [13]. Said about its sound: Recording quality is more muffled than many others found on the site, earning three stars [26]
- **gd90-09-19.sbd.ashley.14674.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 169 min; rated 4.21/5 by 14 [14]. Said about its sound: This soundboard transfer features a crisp low end and slightly higher levels than others [19]

## Around the show

- Reviewer misses Brent but notes Bruce fills in nicely for the band [23]
- Bruce was just breaking in his seat, marking his fourth show as a band member [25]
- Band started a twenty-minute Let It Grow before switching to Ship of Fools, crushing fans [27]
- Reviewer considers this performance significantly better than the following night's concert [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-09-19.138055.mtx.photoleon.t-flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; MTX from Audience recording: Recording by Tom Darian; From Section A Row 19, seat 2 FOB - near center; B&K 4011's ORTF -> ProLnk Cables ->… [1]
- **gd1990-09-19.mtx.hansokolow.fix-96157.97641.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: matrix of DSBD: shnid=85003 and DAUD: shnid=11664 [2]. Also: Matrix uses Charlie Miller's SBD source with analog set one and digital set two; Dave Brotman's FOB Schoeps source was chosen for clarity, with glitches fixed by blending [2]
- **gd90-09-19.schoeps-fob.wiley.11664.sbeok.shnf**: source: Dave Brotman FOB(15th row, Center)-AUD(Scheops)>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN [5]
- **gd90-09-19.sbd.jeffm.3373.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> DAT> CDR> WAV> SHN [13]
- **gd90-09-19.sbd.ashley.14674.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [14]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1990-09-19 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1990-09-19-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [33]
